inline_feedback_applied.description: Spray application on bare drywall must include mandatory wet-on-wet backroll. Dry rolling not permitted.
inline_feedback_applied.resolution: Added separate backroll tasks (TSK_BACKROLL_PRIME_WALL, TSK_BACKROLL_PRIME_CEILING) as mandatory components of spray modules. Notes clarify wet-on-wet requirement.

inline_feedback_applied.description: Project phase distinction: pre-trim (before trim/fixtures) vs post-trim (after everything installed) significantly affects scope.
inline_feedback_applied.resolution: Added project_phase configuration dimension with pre_trim and post_trim values. Created separate cut-in tasks for each phase. Module task maps select appropriate tasks based on phase.

inline_feedback_applied.description: Factor modifiers should be expressed as time multipliers (higher = more time) not rate multipliers.
inline_feedback_applied.resolution: Recalculated all factor modifiers as time multipliers. Values >1.0 indicate increased time required. Added modifier_type field and clarifying notes.

approval_notes: Spec approved after incorporating domain expert feedback on spray backroll requirements, project phase handling, and modifier calculation methodology. All core doctrine checks pass. Ready for production use.
